noncollinear_r4.5.name: noncollinear_r4.5
noncollinear_r4.5.description: KKR (JuKKR, Liechtenstein formula) couplings between Mn2a moments computed in the noncollinear reference state; all pairs up to 4.5 A.
noncollinear_r4.5.listing: every bond appears once from each end (i->j and j->i)

collinear_AFMz_r4.5.name: collinear_AFMz_r4.5
collinear_AFMz_r4.5.description: KKR couplings between Mn2a moments computed in a collinear reference state with the Mn2a moments along +-c; all pairs up to 4.5 A.
collinear_AFMz_r4.5.listing: every bond appears once from each end (i->j and j->i)

noncollinear_r17.name: noncollinear_r17
noncollinear_r17.description: KKR couplings between Mn2a moments in the noncollinear reference state; all pairs up to 17 A.
noncollinear_r17.listing: every bond appears once from each end (i->j and j->i)

mn1_couplings.name: mn1_couplings
mn1_couplings.description: Mn1-Mn2a (2.96 A) and Mn1-Mn1 (2.41 A, along c) couplings that the authors used for a model in which Mn1 carries a moment. They were not computed with KKR.
mn1_couplings.listing: every bond appears once from each end (i->j and j->i)
